name: benchmark-intelligence-platform
description: Deployment entry point for the AI Travel Benchmark Dashboard. Installs both 10_Dashboard and 11_Benchmark_Engine (the Dashboard's server.js hard-imports the Engine's orchestrator), then starts the Dashboard server. Business logic lives in 10_Dashboard/ and 11_Benchmark_Engine/ — this file only wires up deployment.

scripts.postinstall: npm run install:dashboard && npm run install:engine && npm run install:browsers
